title: Lineage record
description: One append-only JSONL line per evaluated genome. Mortality means a candidate stops receiving evolutionary resources — never that it is deleted (§17). A lineage that failed against today's model may succeed against tomorrow's, and resurrection requires that the record survived.

observed_effect.description: Recorded even when it contradicts the prediction. This pairing is the raw material for meta-evolution (§27), which is why it is captured from day one and not acted on until there is enough of it.
